# Test fixtures

Deterministic, checked-in binaries generated by `generate.cjs`. Every photo
fixture uses the same quadrant pattern so orientation and cropping can be
asserted by sampling pixels, not by eyeballing screenshots:

```
+-----------+-----------+
| red       | green     |
| #ff0000   | #00b300   |
+-----------+-----------+
| blue      | yellow    |
| #0000ff   | #ffd400   |
+-----------+-----------+
```

"Top-left is red" always refers to the **rendered** image, i.e. after any
EXIF orientation has been applied — not necessarily the stored pixel bytes.

| File                       | Rendered size      | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `portrait.jpg`             | 600 × 800          | No EXIF orientation tag (implicit orientation 1).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `landscape.jpg`            | 800 × 600          | No EXIF orientation tag.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `square.jpg`               | 700 × 700          | No EXIF orientation tag.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `oversized-4000x3000.jpg`  | 4000 × 3000        | Smooth gradient (small file despite pixel count). Exercises `MAX_WORKING_EDGE` downscaling.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `exif-rotated-90cw.jpg`    | 600 × 800 rendered | Pixel bytes are stored landscape (800 × 600, same quadrant layout as `landscape.jpg`) with an EXIF `Orientation` tag of `6` (rotate 90° CW). Verified empirically in Chromium: a correct orientation-aware decode renders this at 600 × 800 with quadrants **top-left = blue, top-right = red, bottom-left = yellow, bottom-right = green** — i.e. the stored image rotated 90° CW, not the same layout as `portrait.jpg`. Do not assume it matches `portrait.jpg`; assert the rotated map above. jsdom/node-canvas do **not** apply EXIF orientation; only assert on this fixture in Playwright, not Vitest. |
| `corrupt.jpg`              | —                  | 6 garbage bytes with a `.jpg` name. Must produce a friendly decode error, never a crash.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `not-an-image.txt`         | —                  | Plain text with a non-image name. Must be rejected before attempting to decode.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `test-overlay-400x500.png` | 400 × 500          | 4:5 ratio. Opaque cyan (`rgb(0,200,200)`) 40px border; fully transparent (alpha 0) interior beyond the border. Decoupled from the real production overlay so compositing tests don't break if that artwork changes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

Regenerate with:

```bash
node tests/fixtures/generate.cjs
```
